_law: A commit may delete files on purpose, but only by declaring them here by name. Tools/tree_shrink_guard.py clears a shrink ONLY when this file's declared path set equals the commit's actual deletion set exactly -- a partial, superset or wrong-path declaration stays red (selftest L13-L17). Never raise --max-drop to silence a real shrink.
